questions.question: What does Ezekiel 30 announce concerning Egypt?
options: A great harvest along the banks of the Nile
The day of the LORD, a day of doom for Egypt
The return of Israel's exiles from Egypt
A day of peace and rest for Egypt
questions.answer: The day of the LORD, a day of doom for Egypt

questions.question: Whom would God use to bring this judgment on Egypt?
options: Cyrus, the great king of Persia
The king of Tyre and his fleet
